chips: What was my best month this year?
What is driving the business, tires or service?

answers.best_month: May 2026 was the strongest closed month at $14,200 net profit on $38,100 revenue (37.3% margin).
answers.cash: Business checking was $45,200 at Aug 31. August net cash from operations was about $350 after draws.
answers.mix: In August, new tire sales were $23,150 (184 units). Used tires added $3,900 (78 units). Service and repair was $8,200.
answers.sizes: Top size in August was 235/65R17 — 44 units and $5,720 revenue at about $130 per tire.
answers.month: October register through Oct 17 shows $7,037 in sales on 22 tickets (estimates).
